newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Chinese President Jiang Zemin calls on nation to learn from disabled persons' spirit of self-supporting and working hard.
- Beijing opera celebration to be held at People's Theatre to mark anniversary of Mao Zedong's speech on literature and art
- Jiang Zemin meets former U.S. President George Bush, says Sino-U.S. ties face new opportunities
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- President Jiang Zemin gives interview to Politique Internationale magazine
- French President Jacques Chirac to pay state visit to China from May 15 to 18
FINANCIAL NEWS
- March March 1 to May 10, five major banks issued 75.957 billion non-tradeable bonds, 61.75 percent of total for the year
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Norway State Oil Co to set up office in Beijing
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China reports 27 coal mining accidents so far this year
- Output of meat totalled 58 million tonnes in 1996, up 10.3 percent from 1995
CHINA SECURITIES
- China's first quarter electricity production up 4.32 percent from year-ago
CHINA DAILY

- China's exports bottom out and keep strong growth momentum throughout the first four months, says General Administration of Customs. Total foreign trade reached $90.3 billion in first four months, a gain of 13 percent
- The Chinese Academy of Sciences bans all research related to cloning human beings
